text: とり　ポケモンに　つかまって　ここまで　きたよ

structure.jp: とり　ポケモンに　つかまって
structure.en: hanging on to a bird Pokémon
I came all the way here

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: つかまって　ここまで　きた
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins two actions, and here the first shows the way the second was done. つかまって　ここまで　きた = 'I came this far hanging on'.
